analyst.summary: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank just posted its best-ever quarterly profit, up 35% year-on-year, with net interest margin expanding to 4.29% and both gross and net non-performing assets improving to among the lowest levels in the sector. Loan growth is strong and outpacing deposit growth. At roughly 9x earnings, the bank looks statistically inexpensive for the quality of this quarter's numbers, though as a Tamil Nadu-concentrated regional bank it will likely continue to trade at some discount to larger, more diversified private banks.
